items.title: Israel warns attacks on Iran will expand as Trump delays Strait of Hormuz deadline
items.description: Israel has warned it will expand its attacks on Iran as Tehran kept firing missiles at Israel and Gulf nations.

items.title: Red alert in Carnarvon as destructive Cyclone Narelle closes in
items.description: The storm, which has already made landfall in Far North Queensland and the Northern Territory, is now impacting the west Pilbara coast.

items.title: Telstra outage in remote NT community impacting Triple Zero access
items.description: Residents in the remote NT community of Kintore have had difficulty making Triple Zero calls during a six-day Telstra outage, which has also caused issues buying fuel.

items.title: Teenagers brandish knives, hammer at Canberra shopping centre
items.description: Police say they were called to the Canberra Centre about 6:20pm on Friday after reports that a group of young people were involved in a disturbance, brandishing knives and a hammer.

items.title: As Pakistan emerges as a US-Iran broker, it draws on relationships few others have
items.description: Pakistan is positioning itself at the centre of a war it is uniquely placed to influence and cannot afford to ignore, writes Meghna Bali.

items.title: 'There will be tax reform' but treasurer says no decision yet on capital gains
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers commits to tax reform in his upcoming budget, but adds that no decision has yet been taken as to whether capital gains tax will be part of those changes.

items.title: 'Forget it': NSW beachgoers urged to cancel plans amid hazardous weather
items.description: New South Wales beaches will be too dangerous to visit this weekend, with authorities issuing a warning to rock fishers, swimmers and boaters to stay away from the coastline.

items.title: Broncos claim pressure-relieving victory over Dolphins, ending tough week on a high
items.description: The Broncos overpowered the Dolphins 26-22 in the Battle of Brisbane, after Wests Tigers stunned ladder leaders New Zealand Warriors in Auckland.

items.title: Socceroos snatch late win as teen debutant impresses heading into World Cup
items.description: Jordy Bos hits the back of the net as the Socceroos leave it late against Cameroon in Sydney with 18-year-old Lucas Herrington impressing on debut.

items.title: AFL players to lose insurance coverage for brain injuries
items.description: More than 500 AFL players will soon no longer be covered by insurance for brain injuries in their superannuation after Zurich Insurance moved to cut their ability to claim for concussion and head trauma.

items.title: Magpies confirm 'hamstring awareness' for Moore after win over Giants
items.description: Collingwood is expecting to be without its skipper Darcy Moore and his predecessor Scott Pendlebury next week against Brisbane after the pair were hobbled during the win over GWS.

items.title: The 'crown jewels' of the Iranian nuclear program and why the US wants them
items.description: A move from Israel or the United States to find and secure Iran's enriched uranium stockpile would be dangerous, but experts say it is one of the only ways to end the war and prevent it from returning.

items.title: Liberals to retain SA opposition status despite One Nation's second seat, ABC projects
items.description: The ABC is projecting that the Liberals have retained the Adelaide Hills seat of Heysen, meaning the party will be the second largest in the House of Assembly and retain opposition status.

items.title: Jury clears men accused of raping intoxicated woman waiting for an Uber
items.description: Two men accused of raping a young woman they picked up while she waited for an Uber have been acquitted on all charges by a Northern Territory jury.

items.title: New Spirit of Tasmania ferry to be used as Dark Mofo floating art gallery
items.description: The new spirit of Tasmania ferries might not be available for journeys across the Bass Strait yet — but this winter, one of them will take on a new role as an art gallery, during Hobart's Dark Mofo festival.

items.title: NT working to repair flood damaged roads, with more than 1,000 potholes filled
items.description: More than 100 sections of road are closed or impassible following widespread flooding across the Northern Territory, with the cost of repairs set to rise with fuel prices.

items.title: Weekend line-up: Scarpetta, Belle Burden and hot cross buns
items.description: Fire up your remotes, headphones or over and get set for a weekend of entertainment.

items.title: Weekly news quiz: Jet fuel shortages, headbutting whales and an iconic image
items.description: It's been a big week in the news. Did you catch these stories?

items.title: Inflation set to soar as fuel costs hit prices of everyday items from bread to ridesharing
items.description: Fuel surcharges are being applied across a range of industries, from the delivery of bricks to building sites to Australia's biggest rideshare companies, meaning consumer prices are rising.

items.title: Katherine's worst flood in 28 years leaves survivors with disaster 'PTSD'
items.description: As it recovers from its worst flooding in decades, those living in the NT town of Katherine are trying to come to terms with the ongoing threat on their doorstep.

items.title: Hatchet attack on dog at SA golf course prompts public appeal
items.description: A kelpie that was found with "horrific" head wounds at an Adelaide Hills golf course has prompted the RSPCA to issue a public appeal for information. Warning: This story contains details some readers may find distressing.

items.title: Parts of NSW wake up to 'surreal' snowfall in March
items.description: It is still only March, but snow is falling in parts of NSW and the Bureau of Meteorology is checking its record books.

items.title: Justice department confirms not guilty plea by ex-National Trust Tasmania boss on theft charges
items.description: Following the lifting of a suppression order, Tasmania's department of justice has confirmed the former director of the National Trust in Tasmania has pleaded not guilty to stealing almost $150,000 worth of items from his former employer.

items.title: 'I've got a family to support': Sandilands's battle to stay on air in court
items.description: Kyle Sandilands says he wants to "get back to work as quick as possible" as a legal battle between the controversial radio host and his former employer reaches court for the first time.

items.title: Fans rethink driving to SA for AFL Gather Round as global fuel crisis continues
items.description: The SA government and AFL are in discussions to try to keep fans flocking to Adelaide for next month's AFL Gather Round, as the global fuel crisis threatens to disrupt travel plans.
